title: 第3章 还是被盯住第4章 看得头皮发麻
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
回到客栈，关好门窗，李凡这才吐出大铁锅。
看着恢复原样的大铁锅，李凡难免有一点紧张。
拿出一块今天新得到的灵石，李凡小心翼翼的放进大铁锅里。
李凡都感觉不到，自己手心里，已经有不少汗珠。
缓缓拿出灵石，熟悉的灵光再次闪烁起来。
“呼！”
李凡长出一口气，大铁锅的神奇之处并没有消失。
那为什么上次修复完下品飞剑，大铁锅就没反应呢？
难道大铁锅有使用的次数限制？
李凡心中猜测。
先实验一下复制灵石的功能，有没有极限。
李凡开始乐此不疲的实验，不到一个时辰的功夫，李凡身边已经堆出一个小山一般的灵石堆。
同时，李凡也终于找到大铁锅复制灵石的极限。
一百块灵石！
足足复制出一千块灵石。
看着身边这一堆灵石，李凡笑得合不拢嘴。
此刻的他，如同一个老财主，一遍一遍数着这些灵石。
直到自己累的一动不动，李凡这才把所有灵石收进储物袋。
这一觉，睡得并不踏实。
激灵一下，李凡在梦魇中惊醒。

他立刻看向怀里抱着的大铁锅，发现没有任何变化，这才长出一口气。
原来，刚才的噩梦里，李凡梦到自己通过神奇的大铁锅，终于修炼有成，飞升到仙界。
可是，大铁锅的秘密，却不小心暴露，然后自己成为整个仙界大能猎杀的目标。
最后，无数的仙界大能，将自己围住，眼看要将自己碎尸万段，李凡终于从梦魇里醒来。
抹一下额头的冷汗，李凡依旧惊魂未定，大铁锅这个秘密，绝对不能暴露，任何人都不能透露！
平息一下心情，拿出一点干粮，吃饱喝足，李凡继续开始自己的实验。
首先，他还是复制一块灵石，确定大铁锅的神奇功能，又可以继续进行。
李凡初步总结，大铁锅的神奇功能可以每天刷新。
然后，李凡拿出一把从小店铺买来的下品法器废弃的匕首。
这次，依旧是用十次修复功能，这把匕首恢复原貌。
和上次一样，修复完这把下品法器匕首，大铁锅又失去神奇的功能。
无奈，李凡只能等待第二天大铁锅的神奇功能刷新。
接下来的三天时间，李凡继续实验，用大铁锅将剩下的三件下品法器，两把飞剑，一把九环刀全部修复。
然后，李凡又有一点忐忑，下面的一天，他决定实验一下中品法器寒冰剑。
content_en:
After returning to the inn and closing the doors and windows, Li Fan spit out the big iron pot.
Looking at the big iron pot restored to its original shape, Li Fan was inevitably a little nervous.
Taking out a new spirit stone he got today, Li Fan carefully put it into the large iron pot.
Li Fan couldn't even feel that there were already many beads of sweat in his palms.
Slowly taking out the spiritual stone, the familiar spiritual light flickered again.
"Phew!"
Li Fan let out a sigh of relief. The magic of the big iron pot had not disappeared.
Then why did the big iron pot not respond after repairing the low-grade flying sword last time?
Is there a limit to the number of times a large iron pot can be used?
Li Fan guessed in his mind.
Let's first experiment with the function of replicating the spirit stone to see if there is any limit.
Li Fan began to experiment endlessly. In less than an hour, a small mountain-like pile of spiritual stones had been piled up around Li Fan.
At the same time, Li Fan finally found the limit of the big iron pot's ability to replicate spiritual stones.
One hundred spiritual stones!
A full thousand spiritual stones were copied.
Looking at the pile of spiritual stones around him, Li Fan smiled from ear to ear.
At this moment, he was like an old rich man, counting these spiritual stones over and over again.
It wasn't until he was too tired to move that Li Fan put all the spirit stones into his storage bag.
This sleep was not a solid one.
With a jolt, Li Fan woke up from his nightmare.
He immediately looked at the big iron pot in his arms and found that nothing had changed, and then he let out a sigh of relief.
It turned out that in the nightmare just now, Li Fan dreamed that he passed through the magical big iron pot and finally succeeded in cultivation and ascended to the fairy world.
However, the secret of the big iron pot was accidentally exposed, and then he became the target of hunting by the powerful in the entire fairy world.
In the end, countless powerful men from the immortal world surrounded him and were about to tear him into pieces. Li Fan finally woke up from the nightmare.
Wiping the cold sweat from his forehead, Li Fan was still in shock. The secret of the big iron pot must not be exposed, and no one can reveal it!
After calming down, taking out some dry food, eating and drinking, Li Fan continued to start his experiment.
First, he still copied a spiritual stone to confirm the magical function of the big iron pot, and then he could continue.
Li Fan initially concluded that the magical function of the big iron pot can be refreshed every day.
Then, Li Fan took out a discarded dagger that was a low-grade magical weapon bought from a small shop.
This time, the ten-time repair function was still used to restore the dagger to its original appearance.
Just like last time, after repairing this low-grade magic weapon dagger, the big iron pot lost its magical function again.
Helpless, Li Fan could only wait for the magical function of the big iron pot to be refreshed the next day.
In the next three days, Li Fan continued to experiment, using a large iron pot to repair all the remaining three low-grade magical instruments, two flying swords, and a nine-ring knife.
Then, Li Fan felt a little uneasy again. The next day, he decided to experiment with the middle-grade magic weapon Ice Sword.
